Hi, we're planning the seating for our wedding and I'm using this diagram to check the room. The Bride and Groom sit at the top center, so put them there. Table1, Table2 and Table3 go in a row under them. Dj should be on the far right, out of the way of the tables. Cake goes near Table2, it's on the middle table. Is Cake near Table2? Make the Cake white, so it's easy to find. Align Table1, Table2 and Table3 on the horizontal axis. Then distribute them horizontally so the gaps are equal. Rename Dj to Music, my aunt wants that label. Label Bride as "Bride and Groom" so people know. Which table is farthest from the Cake? Undo the last move if the tables jump somewhere strange. Oh, and how many tables do we have in total? Thanks so much.
Label Db as "Customers DB". Then connect Api to Db.
Api is green. Db sits below Api. Cache is a small circle. Now count the circles, please.
Align Box1, Box2 and Box3 on the vertical axis. Is Box2 the same color as Box1? What color is Box3? Thanks.
Delete all the red shapes.
Make C2 a star. Which circle is closest to Hub? And what color is Sensor?
Put a hexagon named Gateway above Lambda. Connect Gateway to Queue and Queue to Lambda. Is Gateway bigger than Lambda?
Move Table to the bottom left. Then make it huge.

Okay I'm sketching our standup flow, it's a mess right now. Yesterday goes to Today, and Today goes to Blockers. If there are blockers, they go to Ask. Make Ask orange, that's our warning color. Is Ask connected to Yesterday? Hmm, probably not, I want to double check. Which shape is the most connected? Rename Blockers to Risks, the product people like that word better. After that, put Done at the bottom right. And connect Ask to Done, because a question gets answered eventually. Undo that last connection, it's wrong. Also list all the orange shapes. Thanks, this helps a lot.
Pls mov Output to teh right of Input. thx
Add a hexagon, call it Gate, and place it near Core.
Paint the team board: Alpha green, Beta red.
Where is Gamma right now? Move it to the top right.
Distribute Top, Mid and Bottom vertically. Then align them on the vertical axis. Thanks, that looks cleaner.
Duplicate Star 4 times. Then undo that, too many.
Connect Start to End.
Make Node1 bigger. Shrink Node2 a bit.

Okay this is my daughter's science project and she wants the planets in order. The Sun is in the center, I think you can put it there. Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars and Belt should go left to right, from the Sun outward. Hmm, can we do it as a row? Arrange them in a row, I think that's good. Connect Sun to Mercury, then Mercury to Venus, and so on to Belt. Make the Sun yellow, obviously. Make Earth blue. Make Mars red. Is Earth between Venus and Mars? Which planet is the biggest? Thanks for helping her with this!
Send Cloud to the back. Bring Star to the front.
Redo the last thing you undid.
From now on boxes are gray, so new ones start gray too. Put a new box under Dock. Is Dock gray?
Make Dock a diamond and put it in the middle of the screen. Thanks.

Hey, sketching the club roster for the new season and I want the lines to be right before I send it. Connect Captain to Coach. Connect Winger1 and Winger2 to Captain. Keeper should sit to the left of Coach, I want the keeper on the side. Is Keeper left of Coach? Add a hexagon named Striker below Winger2. Make the Striker orange since it's the new signing. Also move Keeper a bit up, around 30 pixels. Can you check which shape is the most connected? Also I'd like the Winger1 and Winger2 to be the same size, maybe medium. Make them both medium. Hmm, I'm not sure if the Striker should connect to Captain or Coach. Let's leave it for now. How many players do we have on the board? Thanks!
Keeper is red. Coach is a large square. Now make the Winger1 a triangle.
What's the color of the Logo? Make it navy.
Connect Zed to Yak and Yak to Xan with dotted lines. Is Zed linked to Xan? How many arrows do we have now?
Delete Zed.

I'm mapping the new bus route for the city council and I need it clean for the slides. Stop1, Stop2 and Stop3 are all on the main road, so put them in a row. Connect Depot to Stop1, then Stop1 to Stop2, Stop2 to Stop3 and Stop3 to Mall. Which stop is farthest from Depot? Mall is the terminal, so make it huge. Make Depot navy so it stands out on the map. Hmm, navy might be too dark, make it blue instead. Move Stop2 a bit to the right, around 40 pixels, because the old map had it there. Is Stop1 closest to Depot? Duplicate Stop1 two times, there are two more stops we forgot about. Oh, and rename Stop3 to Harbor, that's the local name. Put the Depot at the bottom left corner. Can you list all the circles? Thanks, the council meets on Monday.
Make Mall a large star. Also make it yellow. Thanks.
Connect Alpha to Beta and Beta to Gamma. Then connect Gamma to Alpha to close the loop. Is there a cycle?

Working on a mobile app mockup for a fitness tracker and I'm not a designer so bear with me. Header should be at the top, and Body goes right under it. Nav sits at the bottom, move it there please. Make Header large. Align Header and Body on the vertical axis so they line up. Cta is the big call to action button, make it orange and huge. Is Cta below Body? Footer goes under Nav, put it at the very bottom. Connect Header to Body with a plain line, it's just a visual connection. Which shape is the leftmost? Hmm, that should be Nav, right? Then rename Cta to StartWorkout because the dev team calls it that. Undo the last move if the nav bar broke. How many shapes are on the screen? Thanks, I'll show this to my friend tomorrow.
Swap Header and Body, please.

I'm a biology teacher making a food web diagram for year 8. Plankton feeds Fish, and Kelp feeds Fish too. Fish feeds Shark. Make Shark a large red diamond so the kids remember it is the top predator. Pollution goes into Coral, can you link them? Hmm, pollution isn't food, let's drop that line. Connect Coral to Kelp with a dotted line, it's a symbiosis. Put Plankton at the bottom left. Move Kelp above Coral. Is Shark bigger than Fish? Which shape has the most connections? Rename Kelp to Seaweed, that's what the textbook says. Undo the last change if the layout is worse. Thanks!
Is the Logo red? Then make it green.
Put a star named Target at the top right, then align it with Logo on the horizontal axis.
How many squares do I have? Count the diamonds too.
Are there any shapes that aren't blue? Thanks.
Make the newest diamond green. Move the first star to the left of Dia1. Thanks.
Make all the boxes that are not blue gray. Then enlarge every square that is not red. Which one is biggest?
